descriptionChirho: To burst forth, rush out, or come forth with force -- used of physical emergence and metaphorical labor. In Ps 22:9 (ET 22:10), God is the one who drew the psalmist from the womb (gochi, Qal participle). In Job 38:8, the sea burst forth (begicho) as from a womb. In Job 40:23, the river bursts forth (yagiyach). In Judg 20:33, Israel rushed out (megiyach, Hiphil). In Ezek 32:2, the addressee burst forth (wattagach) among the nations. In Mic 4:10, Zion is commanded to groan/push forth (wagochi) in labor. Glosses uniformly confirm emergence: arb indafa'a, spa irrumpir/brotar, kor teojyeo naoda, hin nikalnewaalaa/phuutaa.
